The POSIX shell is available on every Unix system. quarto-term works with it using standard `PS1` prompt detection.

```yaml
extensions:
  term:
    shell: sh
```

## Basic Usage

```{term}
echo "Hello from sh ($(readlink -f $(which sh) 2>/dev/null || which sh))"
```

## Loops

```{term}
i=1
while [ $i -le 5 ]; do
  echo "Count: $i"
  i=$((i + 1))
done
```

## Functions

```{term}
factorial() {
  if [ $1 -le 1 ]; then echo 1
  else echo $(( $1 * $(factorial $(( $1 - 1 ))) ))
  fi
}
factorial 6
```

## Text Processing

```{term}
printf "banana\napple\ncherry\ndate\n" | sort | nl
```
